WHAT: Whisper inference wrapped with duration-aware timeout

WHERE: src-tauri/src/transcription/backends/whisper.rs

HOW:
- WhisperConfig cloned as config_owned before spawn_blocking
- spawn_blocking moves state + config_owned into closure
- FullParams created inside closure from cloned config (solves lifetime issue — params can't borrow from &config with non-static lifetime)
- tokio::time::timeout(max(60s, 3 × audio_duration)) wraps spawn_blocking
- On timeout: Err returned, DynamicTranscriber falls back to FluidAudio... wait, no — Whisper IS the fallback. Returns error.

WHY: Whisper .full() had zero timeout. Could hang forever on large audio or malformed input.

GOTCHA: spawn_blocking thread CANNOT be cancelled on timeout — whisper-rs wraps C code. Thread leaks but eventually returns. Known accepted tradeoff. Do NOT try to kill it — could corrupt whisper-rs state.
